scene: The shrine reveals hidden transit tokens.
picture: Side-scrolling flat view of a transit quay below the terrace. On the far left stands a brass-gated spiral lift shaft. Beside it, the player in her lilac headscarf and mustard coat holds three tokens. At the centre, a wooden river barge floats against a dock. On the far right sits a glass-roofed trolley.
shown: a winding glass spiral lift shaft with open brass gate on far left
a striped canal barge tied to a low dock at the centre
a sleek glass-roofed trolley waiting on polished rails on the far right
